name: A Pittsburgh rowhouse garden

place_source.title: Wikidata: Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania (Q1342), coordinate location (P625) and elevation above sea level (P2044)

blurb: A narrow back garden behind a brick rowhouse on a Pittsburgh hillside: a lawn, a border, a serviceberry and a redbud against the neighbouring wall, hemlock and white cedar along the fence, and a strip of lawn where squirrels and chipmunks work the leaf litter. Robins and cardinals come in by day, raccoons and big brown bats after dark, and a red-tailed hawk works the tall trees overhead.

facts.text: Pittsburgh is either Dfa (hot-summer humid continental) or Cfa (humid subtropical) under the Koppen classification, depending on whether the 0 C or the -3 C isotherm is used; it lies in USDA plant hardiness zone 6b, except along the rivers where it is 7a.
